title: agent-fs dependencies
description: The crates Cargo.toml depends on, and what each is for. The protocol and system references are in src/.dev/references.json.

entities.title: blake3
entities.relevance: Content etags: the first 64 bits of a file's or a reply's BLAKE3 hash.

entities.title: ignore
entities.relevance: Every walk of search, list and outline: .gitignore, .ignore, git excludes, globs, hidden files and depth.

entities.title: regex and memchr
entities.summary: ripgrep's regex engine and byte search with runtime-detected SIMD.
entities.relevance: Matching search patterns over file bytes, counting lines and finding line ends.

entities.title: regex-syntax
entities.summary: The regex crate's parser and literal extractor.
entities.relevance: Extracting the literals every match must start or end with, for the trigram index.

entities.title: tree-sitter and its grammar crates
entities.summary: Incremental parsers; the grammar crates (rust, python, javascript, typescript, go, java, c, cpp) compile C at build time.

entities.title: similar
entities.relevance: Line hunks for diff replies and diff_since, with a 250 ms timeout.

entities.title: serde and serde_json
entities.relevance: The JSON protocol: strict request structs and JSON replies.

entities.title: clap
entities.relevance: The call, jsonl and serve subcommands, --help and --version.

entities.title: libc
entities.summary: Raw bindings to the C library.
entities.relevance: Read hints (O_NOATIME, posix_fadvise, F_RDAHEAD), the macOS AIO calls and the io_uring statx and errno values.

entities.title: io-uring
entities.summary: Rust bindings to Linux io_uring; a dependency only on Linux.

entities.title: tempfile
entities.summary: Temporary files and directories; a dev-dependency only.
entities.relevance: Fixture directories in the unit and end-to-end tests.
